name: Native gold
definition: native gold sold as a mineral specimen (nugget, crystal or wire, on or off matrix); a refined bar, round or coin sold by weight is F3.
notes: crystallized native gold thumbnail specimen sold

name: Pyrite
definition: iron sulfide mineral specimen (cubes, clusters, suns, on or off matrix).

name: Fluorite
definition: calcium fluoride mineral specimen (crystals, clusters, octahedra, specimens on matrix, polished pieces).

name: Quartz
definition: uncut quartz specimen that no separate quartz kind covers (rock crystal points and clusters, tumbled and polished quartz).

name: Amethyst
definition: uncut purple quartz specimen (geode, point, cluster, tumbled stone, slab, sphere); a faceted or cabochon amethyst is F6.5.2.05.

name: Agate
definition: uncut or polished banded chalcedony specimen (nodule, geode, slab, tumbled stone).

name: Jasper
definition: uncut or polished opaque microcrystalline quartz specimen (rough, tumbled stone, slab, sphere); a cut cabochon of jasper falls under the F-4 test into F6.5 when attested.

name: Opal
definition: opal specimen, matrix piece or uncut nodule; a loose opal cut en cabochon or faceted, or opal rough sold as cutting material, is F6.5.2.10.

name: Corundum
definition: uncut corundum specimen, including ruby and sapphire crystals on or off matrix; cut stones and cutting rough are F6.5.2.01 and F6.5.2.02.

name: Calcite
definition: calcium carbonate mineral specimen (crystals, clusters, specimens on matrix).

name: Malachite
definition: copper carbonate mineral specimen (botryoidal or banded rough, polished pieces, slabs).

name: Barite
definition: barium sulfate mineral specimen (bladed crystals, clusters, roses); level provisional (CV-27).

name: Tourmaline
definition: uncut tourmaline specimen (crystals, clusters, on or off matrix); facet-grade rough sold by weight and cut stones are F6.5.2.07.

name: Garnet
definition: uncut garnet-group specimen (crystals on or off matrix, tumbled stones); cut stones and cutting rough are F6.5.2.06.

name: Granite
definition: coarse-grained intrusive igneous rock sample.

name: Basalt
definition: fine-grained extrusive igneous rock sample.

name: Obsidian
definition: natural volcanic glass sample.

name: Sandstone
definition: sedimentary rock sample of cemented sand grains.

name: Marble
definition: metamorphic rock sample of recrystallised carbonate.

name: Slate
definition: fine-grained foliated metamorphic rock sample.

name: Rock and mineral teaching set
definition: kit of unlike labelled specimens (rocks across classes, and minerals or fossils) sold, standardised and compared as one object, usually for teaching (S3a, K-1); a mixed set not sold as a teaching kit is filed by its item of greatest value.
notes: 48 rocks in three kits by class

name: Ammonite
definition: fossil ammonoid shell, whole, split, polished or on matrix, including unworked stones kept for a religious tradition (F-17).

name: Trilobite
definition: fossil trilobite, prepared on or off matrix.

name: Belemnite
definition: fossil belemnite guard or other straight cephalopod.

name: Echinoderm fossil
definition: fossil echinoderm (crinoid, starfish, sea urchin, blastoid).

name: Ammolite
definition: gem-quality iridescent ammonite shell material, rough or cut (F-4).

name: Fossil shark tooth
definition: fossil tooth of a shark or ray.

name: Dinosaur fossil
definition: fossil tooth, bone or claw of a dinosaur (`part` attribute).

name: Fossil fish
definition: fossil fish, whole or partial, usually on matrix.

name: Petrified wood
definition: fossil wood replaced by silica or other minerals, rough, slab or polished.

name: Stromatolite
definition: layered fossil structure built by microbial mats, rough or polished.

name: Amber
definition: fossilised tree resin, raw, polished or cut, with or without inclusions (the inclusion's taxon is a tag).

name: Copal
definition: young, partly fossilised tree resin, sold beside amber.
notes: Copal Insects category 14 items beside Baltic amber

name: Iron meteorite
definition: meteorite made mainly of iron-nickel metal.

name: Pallasite
definition: stony-iron meteorite of olivine crystals in iron-nickel metal.

name: Carbonaceous chondrite
definition: chondrite rich in carbon compounds and water-bearing minerals.

name: Ordinary chondrite
definition: the common stony meteorite of chondrules (H, L, LL groups).

name: Lunar meteorite
definition: achondrite meteorite ejected from the Moon.

name: Martian meteorite
definition: achondrite meteorite ejected from Mars.

name: Tektite and impactite
definition: natural glass or rock formed by a meteorite impact (tektites, impact glass, impactites).
